sn55.2:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
sn55.2:2.2: idha bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.2:2.3: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.2:2.4: dhamme aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo …pe… paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī”ti.
sn55.2:2.5: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
sn55.2:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.2:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti.
sn55.2:3.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
